description: Search consumer-product safety notices (CPSC US, EU Safety Gate, Health Canada, GOV.UK OPSS, ACCC AU, France RappelConso) by free text and/or authority, jurisdiction, category, hazard, manufacturer, strict-recall classification, and publication date range. Returns up to 100 notices with headline fields. FDA food/drug/device and vehicle recalls are excluded. Traded as evidence, not clearance: no result means no matching record in this bounded corpus, never that the product is safe.

is_recall.description: true selects strict recalls; false selects other classified safety actions

jurisdiction.description: ISO country e.g. US, GB, CA, AU

name: recalls_search
title: Search safety notices
